ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: I'm a stateless routing layer, so I evaluate each query on its own, but to answer your question: I weighted the explicit instruction-following demand ("don't overcomplicate it," "get it right") most heavily. Plover's higher IFEval (89.8 vs 85.3) and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 83.2) scores indicate a better fit for a task where adherence to constraints and getting the deliverable right are the stated priorities. Avocet's documented aversion to open-ended generative work was a minor consideration, though its capability there is actually strong.
